name: Governance and corpus legal simulator
note: Built against the placeholder, in parallel with the venue rather than as a subtree of it. Corpus scanned 2026-08-29: generic federal statute text and public case law (Title VI, § 1983, 17 U.S.C. § 201, FERPA, a template enabling act), no personal names, no student records, no institution-specific provisions. The collision is architectural, not content.

survival.duration: indefinite — statute text and case law age slowly
survival.survives_gallery: yes — the corpus is a document set, not an installation
survival.irl_contingency: Runs from a static file server, NOT from file:// — corrected 2026-08-29 by the engineering vantage against this file's earlier claim that it runs offline. 14 requests, all same-origin: no font, no CDN, no analytics, no API, no dependencies installed. The real no-browser contingency is sim/cli.mjs, which is text.
survival.note: Earlier entry here overstated survivability. Corrected against measurement supplied by the project itself.

partial_compliance: Fully resolved. Merged the shell at af83ccd, dropped the contested edits, re-added its card in the shell's idiom on its own branch, adopted the officer-corpus model at ba2422b, and retargeted PR #3 to the venue branch. P7, P8 and P13 all clear against it.
merged_upstream: af83ccd — merged the venue shell; adopted the officer-corpus model at ba2422b
_owner_note: This file is owned by the project it describes. The venue assembles it and never edits another project's copy; a sibling edits only its own. That is the whole point of the split.

awaiting_owner.question: Add a GitHub Actions workflow so the gates run without a session?
awaiting_owner.detail: The repo has no .github. npm test (77), check, check:propose, verify --strict and outstanding all run only when a session chooses to run them. Offered twice; not answered. A stale premise (ENG-P1) shipped for hours because nothing was watching.

awaiting_owner.question: Build the four verbs — document / produce / share / perform — as the site's structure?
awaiting_owner.detail: Owner said yes, then the conversation moved to Donald v. UKA. Not built. This replaces the literary/object/performance/relational framing, which the owner corrected as classification rather than action.

awaiting_owner.question: The artist's statement — which lines survive in the owner's own hand?
awaiting_owner.detail: Drafted from the 2023 bio. Every line touching grief, Blackness, or what the work is for is a placeholder and will read as borrowed until overwritten. 'And now in systems' was flagged as the weakest phrase in it.

awaiting_owner.question: What is the paralegal role actually called?
awaiting_owner.detail: Transcribed as 'Enochian paralegal' and 'ENaki in paralegal'. Recorded as an unresolved name rather than guessed at. The corpus/paralegal/ officer is filed under the generic name until corrected. Nothing depends on it; the role is built either way.

awaiting_owner.question: Q3 FORM versus RELIANCE — who owns the test?
awaiting_owner.detail: Unresolved and unowned since the Q3 arbitration declined to pick. Fellowships locates the danger in form (a judgment in a file shaped like a spec); engineering locates it in reliance (a claim a reader is invited to act on). They diverge on real cases and the next straddling file gets classified by whoever finds it.
